question: An electron and a proton enter the same uniform magnetic field with equal speeds perpendicular to the field. Which particle will describe a circular path of smaller radius? Give reason.

options.A: The proton, because its positive charge gives a smaller radius.
options.B: Both have the same radius because their charge magnitudes and speeds are equal.
options.C: The electron, because $r=\dfrac{mv}{|q|B}$ and its mass is much smaller than the proton mass.
options.D: Neither follows a circular path because their charges have opposite signs.
